subject: Intro + demo for CorePlatform — exec presence and slot consolidation
messages:
From: Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@coreplatform.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: solutions@coreplatform.com
Date: 2029-07-01T22:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + demo request — Redwood for CorePlatform

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier today. Our CTO (Asha Patel) and VP of Architecture (Tom Nguyen) are keen to see a short, targeted demo focused on latency/cost tradeoffs and private deployment options. Can we lock a 45-minute slot next week where they can attend live?

High-level goals:
- Understand Redwood Dedicated vs Private networking model for our compliance needs
- Walk through SLOs and rollback/rollout controls
- Ask about cost levers (batching, quantization recommendations) for sustained loads

Preferable times: Tue/Wed 10–11am PT or Thu afternoon. We can be flexible; if those windows won't work please suggest two alternatives.

I attached our high-level timeline and mutual action plan for procurement.

Thanks — Maya
Maya Lopez
Head of Platform Partnerships
CorePlatform Inc

Hi Maya — great to meet you today.

We can absolutely do a focused 45-minute session that covers the items you listed. Ben (our Head of Solutions) and Karthik (infrastructure/Private deployments) should join to cover SLA/architecture and deployment options.

Proposed slots (PT):
1) Tue 2029-07-09 10:30–11:15am PT
2) Wed 2029-07-10 10:00–10:45am PT
3) Thu 2029-07-11 3:00–3:45pm PT

If none of those fit, tell us two alternate windows and we’ll pivot. Can you confirm which execs will be on the call (CTO/VP names) and whether they want a quick pre-call of 10 minutes to surface any compliance questions?

I attached a compact demo agenda and call goals to keep things tight.

Best,
Hannah
